selected.rationale: The Wellness Optimizer tracks supplements and workouts and expects science-backed claims, aligning with the advertiser's focus on adaptogens and functional drinks.
The Gen Z Aesthete has a category affinity for functional beverages and values visual, identity-expressive products, which matches a mid-tier non-alcoholic sparkling drink alternative.
The Fitness Enthusiast seeks recovery and functional beverages as part of their workout lifestyle, fitting the advertiser's value proposition of feeling good without a hangover.

rejected.reason: The Busy Parent prioritizes family-friendly products and kids items, which does not match a social functional beverage intended as a cocktail alternative.
The Pet Parent focuses strictly on pet health, supplies, and food, lacking alignment with a human beverage product.
The Affluent Classic prefers heritage apparel, home goods, and travel with a high AOV, which does not align with a trendy mid-tier functional sparkling drink.
The Sustainability Buyer focuses heavily on supply chains and ethical footprints for apparel, clean beauty, and refillables rather than functional beverages.
The Convenience-First Millennial prioritizes instant delivery and quick commerce for meal kits and subscriptions, whereas this advertiser operates on a one-off DTC model.
The Value-Conscious Shopper seeks discount-forward household and grocery items, which contrasts with the mid-tier premium positioning of a functional adaptogenic beverage.
The Gifter looks for gift sets and impressive presentation for holidays, which does not align with a casual functional beverage purchased for personal consumption.
